case_number: 2025 INSC 254; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No(s). 4297 of 2023)
summary: Marriage lasted 80 days; appellant alleged domestic abuse in USA; respondent filed multiple criminal and civil cases in India; trial court directed extradition after appellant failed to appear; High Court dismissed revision; appellant sought dissolution of marriage under Article 142 alleging irretrievable breakdown and abuse of legal process; respondent countered with dowry-related maltreatment claims; issue centers on misuse of legal process vs. legitimate grievances.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 26, Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
